## Card System Exploration — Complete Report

I thoroughly explored the card system across the entire `Assets/_Project` directory. The system is built around **data config classes**, **ScriptableObject databases**, an **event-channel flow**, a **UI selection manager**, and — critically — **hardcoded card-effect switch statements embedded directly inside `PlayerController` and its subclasses**.

---

### 1. Card-Related Scripts Found (9 files)

All located under `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/CardData/` (plus one event-channel SO):

| File | Class | Inherits | Responsibility |
|------|-------|----------|----------------|
| `CardData/CardConfigBase.cs` | `CardConfigBase` | (none, `[Serializable]` POCO) | Base card data: `Name`, `Content`, `Value`, `Quality` (all public fields) |
| `CardData/CardConfigEX.cs` | `CardConfigEX` | `CardConfigBase` | Adds `Stackable` bool — for character-exclusive cards |
| `CardData/CardConfigPublicEpic.cs` | `CardConfigPublicEpic` | `CardConfigBase` | Empty marker subclass (epic quality public cards) |
| `CardData/CardConfigPublicLegend.cs` | `CardConfigPublicLegend` | `CardConfigBase` | Empty marker subclass (legend quality) |
| `CardData/CardConfigPublicNormal.cs` | `CardConfigPublicNormal` | `CardConfigBase` | Empty marker subclass (normal quality) |
| `CardData/CardDatabaseEX.cs` | `CardDatabaseEX` | `ScriptableObject` | **SO database** of exclusive cards: `cardsEX_WizardBoy[]`, `cardsEX_BingNv[]` (menu "小法师卡牌数据库") |
| `CardData/CardDatabasePublic.cs` | `CardDatabasePublic` | `ScriptableObject` | **SO database** of public cards: `cardsPublicNormal[]`, `cardsPublicEpic[]`, `cardsPublicLegend[]` (menu "公用卡牌数据库") |
| `CardData/CharacterCardType.cs` | `CharacterCardType` (static) | (none) | String constants `WizardBoy = "OnReceiveCard_WizardBoy"`, `BingNv = "OnReceiveCard_BingNv"` — used to pick the EX card pool |
| `Core/EventSystem/CardConfigEventChannelSO.cs` | `CardConfigEventChannelSO` | `BaseEventChannelSO<CardConfigBase>` | Typed event channel carrying a card; exposed as `cardReceivedChannel` in `PlayerChannelsSO` / `EventChannelContainerSO` |

### 2. PlayerController + Inheritance Hierarchy

- **Base:** `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Controllers/Character/PlayerController.cs` → `class PlayerController : MonoBehaviour`
- **Subclasses** (3 found via `: PlayerController`):
  - `Controllers/Character/WizardBoy.cs` → `class WizardBoy : PlayerController`
  - `Controllers/Character/BingNv.cs` → `class BingNv : PlayerController`
  - `Controllers/Character/LittleRedGirl.cs` → `class LittleRedGirl : PlayerController`

### 3. Card Effect Application Code — `OnApplicationCard` (THE KEY FINDING)

The card-effect logic is **hardcoded as `switch` statements on the card's `Name` string** inside the controllers. There is no polymorphic effect/strategy object — effects are dispatched by literal Chinese card-name strings.

**`PlayerController.OnApplicationCard(CardConfigBase card)` (virtual, ~line 568):**
- Registered as listener on `cardReceivedChannel` in `OnEnable` (line 200), unregistered in `OnDisable` (line 218).
- Contains a giant `switch (card.Name)` with ~24 hardcoded cases grouped by quality:
  - Normal: "锋利的短剑"→AddAttackPower, "饱满的生命"→AddMaxHealth, "温暖的篝火"→healthRecover, "敏锐的直觉"→AddCriticalChance, "坚韧的意志"→AddDefensePower, "涌动的暗劲"→AddCriticalMultiplier, "迅捷的手腕"→ReduceAttackInterval, "稚嫩四叶草"→AddLuckRate
  - Epic: "锐利的狼牙","不朽的壁垒","巨人的血脉","涌动的生机","鹰眼的凝视","断罪的裁决","狂乱的舞步","青年四叶草" (same effect families)
  - Legend: "弑神的魔剑","圣光的庇护","永恒的生命","神愈的圣光","必然的邂逅","终末的号角","极限的超越","幸运四叶草"
- Effects call `attributePlayer.AddAttackPower(card.Value)`, `AddMaxHealth`, `SetHealthRecover`, `AddCriticalChance`, etc. Some also raise `skillQueryChannel` (e.g. `SkillQueryType.AddLuckRate`).
- **Hardcoded numeric literal observed:** in WizardBoy, `attributePlayer.AddAttackPower(20)` (magic number 20, ignores `card.Value`).

**`WizardBoy.OnApplicationCard` (override, ~line 104):** calls `base.OnApplicationCard(card)` then a character-specific `switch`:
- "流光穿透"→AddMaxAttackCount(1), "流光连射"→AddComboCount(1), "惊鸿照影"→SetCurrentElement(Lightning)+SwitchElement+AddAttackPower(**20** hardcoded), "森芒初露"→SetCurrentElement(Grass)+SwitchElement+healthRecover+=2, "流光分裂"→SetSplit(true)+AddSplitCount(1), "碎雪回风"→SetCurrentElement(Winter)+AddAttackPower(**20**)

**`BingNv.OnApplicationCard` (override, ~line 171):** calls `base.OnApplicationCard(card)` then:
- "凤羽流火"→AddAttackPower+UnlockElement(Fire), "木翎回春"→healthRecover+UnlockElement(Grass), "雷翎惊鸿"→UnlockElement(Lightning)+AddAttackPower, "叠羽追风"→AddComboCount, "穿林打叶"→AddMultiTargetCount, "一羽千翎"→AddSplitCount+SetSplit(true)

**`LittleRedGirl`** has **NO** `OnApplicationCard` override — only pet (Charmander) spawning. It inherits the base switch only.

### 4. Card Flow / Application Entry Points

- **UI trigger:** `Assets/_Project/Scripts/UI/MagicUpgradeManager.cs` (`class MagicUpgradeManager : MonoBehaviour`) — the upgrade panel. `OnCardPointerClick` raises `EventChannelLocator.MainContainer.cardReceivedChannel.Raise(cardData[index])` — this is the single dispatch point that triggers `OnApplicationCard`.
- **Card drawing/selection:** `Assets/_Project/Scripts/UI/MagicUpgradeInfoManager.cs` — handles `SkillQueryType.GetRandomEXCard`, `GetThreeRandomEXCards`, `GetThreeRandomCards`; contains `GetThreeRandomCards()`, `GetRandomEXCard(cardType)`, `GetRandomCardByQuality(...)`, `GetRandomFromArrayWithStackable(CardConfigEX[])`. (This file was located via search but not fully read — see gaps.)

### 5. ScriptableObject Card Configs

- `CardDatabaseEX` and `CardDatabasePublic` (both `ScriptableObject`, with `CreateAssetMenu`) are the only card SOs. The per-card configs (`CardConfigBase`/`EX`/`PublicNormal|Epic|Legend`) are plain `[Serializable]` classes nested as arrays inside those databases — **not individual SO assets**. So card "stats" live as serialized array entries, but the **effect behavior is NOT data-driven** — it is hardcoded in the controller switches.

### 6. Enums / Switches on Card Types/Effects

- There is **no `enum` for card types/effects**. Dispatch is by `string Name` only.
- Quality is also a string (`"普通"`/`"史诗"`/`"传说"`) — `MagicUpgradeManager.SetSingleCardData` switches on `cardData.Quality.ToString()` to pick color/effect index. `CardConfigBase.Quality` is a raw `string` field.
- `SkillQueryType` enum (`SkillQueryEventChannelSO.cs`) includes card-related members: `GetRandomEXCard`, `GetThreeRandomEXCards`, `GetThreeRandomCards`, `AddLuckRate`, `GetLuckRate`.
- Other switches exist on `Element` (Lightning/Winter/Grass/Fire) inside WizardBoy/BingNv for pool init — not card types.
